exercises.prompt: What marks the indicative mood on يَكْتُبُونَ (3mp)?
exercises.explanation: يَكْتُبُونَ belongs to al-afʿāl al-khamsah; its indicative sign is the retention of final nūn.

feedback.rule: Al-afʿāl al-khamsah mark rafʿ by retaining final nūn.

exercises.prompt: True or False: Prefixing the future particle سَـ changes the imperfect verb from indicative to subjunctive.
exercises.explanation: False. Future particles سَـ and سَوْفَ do not alter the indicative mood of the imperfect verb.

feedback.rule: سَـ and سَوْفَ have no mood-governing effect.
